name: ShotStream
model_version: ShotStream shotstream_merged.pt (causal multi-shot next-shot generation, 4-step DMD, no CFG) on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B; code KlingAIResearch/ShotStream@c6a11719ee8a

weights.repo: KlingTeam/ShotStream@225806ba (shotstream_merged.pt, shotstream.yaml, default_config.yaml) + Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B (umT5-XXL text encoder, Wan2.1 VAE, DiT config)

notes: Text-to-video only: an opening image cannot be given, so the image + text (i2v) track is not registered. 832x480 at 16 fps. Upstream multi-shot rollout streamed block by block (3 latents, 12 frames): each shot is 21 latents (81 frames, 5 s), conditioned on 6 frames sampled from the earlier shots (last 5 shots) with shot-aware RoPE and per-shot captions. Interaction = next-shot generation: an instruction (user_prompt or camera_control text, verbatim) starts a new shot at the next block with caption '<init prompt>shot<k>:<instruction>' (upstream global + shot caption format); a shot that reaches 21 latents continues as a new shot with the same caption. The model has no camera input; camera_control text is the shot caption.
